value.body: An underwriter reviews each insurance proposal and decides whether the insurer will accept the risk, and on what terms and premium. Employers include life, health and general insurance companies and their back-office centres. A typical day involves reading proposal forms, medical or property reports and financial documents, and recording decisions in the underwriting system.

items.label: Typical entry
items.value: B.Com (Banking & Insurance), BBA or any graduate

value.title: How you get in
value.body: Freshers usually join an insurer as an underwriting trainee or executive and learn the company's guidelines on the job. Clearing the Insurance Institute of India exams helps with progression. Health underwriting teams sometimes prefer candidates with a life-science or nursing background.

value.title: At a glance
items: Work is desk-based and rule-driven, with growing use of automated underwriting for simple cases.
Next roles: senior underwriter, underwriting manager, product or pricing roles.
